🔥 संजू बाबा का स्वैग और एकदम नया डिजिटल ad कैंपेन हुआ है रिलीज! 🎬

बॉटल में फुल एटीट्यूड, मार्केट में चल रहा है तगड़ा ड्रामा। 😎

1. अभिनेता Sanjay Dutt के co-founded ब्रांड The Glenwalk ने Dominance Reserve 48% ABV स्कॉच व्हिस्की के लिए नया डिजिटल ad कैंपेन लॉन्च कर दिया है। 🥃

2. इस कैंपेन में Sunny Leone और Tanuj Virwani नजर आ रहे हैं, जो Instagram और YouTube पर छाया हुआ है। 📱

3. कैंपेन का टैगलाइन “48% ABV. 100% Sanju’s Attitude” रखा गया है, जिसमें 750 ml बोतल की कीमत महाराष्ट्र में Rs 1,698 है और कंपनी जल्द Rs 555 में 200 ml पैक भी लाएगी। 💰

4. ब्रांड का दावा है कि ये महाराष्ट्र की स्कॉच कैटेगरी में नंबर 1 पोजीशन पर है और Madeira, Portugal में हुए Spirits Selection by Concours Mondial de Bruxelles 2026 में 7 साल पुराने को Grand Gold और 5 साल पुराने को Silver मेडल मिला है। 🏆

5. Sanjay Dutt का कहना है कि यह बोल्ड एटीट्यूड दिखाता है, जबकि Cartel Bros के co-founder Mokksh Sani का दावा है कि यह भारतीय ग्राहकों की पसंद और kadak character को ध्यान में रखकर बनाई गई है। 🗣️

क्या आपने सनी Leone और तनुज Virwani वाला यह नया ad देखा है? 👇

ctx.text:
The Glenwalk, co-founded by actor Sanjay Dutt, has launched a new digital advertising campaign for its Dominance Reserve 48% ABV Scotch whisky. Featuring Sunny Leone and Tanuj Virwani, the campaign is built around the tagline, “48% ABV. 100% Sanju’s Attitude.” It is currently running on digital platforms, including Instagram and YouTube.
The campaign highlights the brand’s 48% alcohol-by-volume expression, with the 750 ml bottle priced at Rs 1,698 in Maharashtra. The company has also announced plans to introduce a 200 ml pack in the state at Rs 555. The smaller format is expected to expand the product’s availability to consumers looking for a lower-priced pack.
Speaking about the campaign, Sanjay Dutt, co-founder of The Glenwalk, said, “The Glenwalk represents a bold attitude and a distinctive identity. The 48% ABV Dominance Reserve reflects that spirit, and the campaign captures the attitude and character that we want the brand to stand for. It is exciting to see this proposition come alive through a creative campaign that brings together a strong concept and an engaging narrative.”
Mokksh Sani, founder of Living Liquidz and co-founder of Cartel Bros, said the product was developed with changing consumer preferences in mind. “The Indian whisky consumer is evolving, with a growing appreciation for bold, distinctive expressions that deliver a stronger experience. At The Glenwalk, we recognised this shift and wanted to create a Scotch whisky that truly resonates with the Indian palate. With India’s first 48% ABV Scotch whisky, we bring together the authenticity of Scottish craftsmanship and a higher strength that gives the expression its unmistakably kadak character. For us, it is about understanding what today’s Indian consumer is looking for and delivering a whisky that stands apart in both character and strength.”
The company has also cited recent recognition at the Spirits Selection by Concours Mondial de Bruxelles 2026 in Madeira, Portugal. According to the brand, The Glenwalk Blended 48%, 7 Years received a Grand Gold medal, while its 5-year expression won a Silver medal.
The Glenwalk is marketed by Cartel Bros, which describes the whisky as Scottish-made. The brand also claims the No. 1 position in Maharashtra’s Scotch category. These market rankings and product distinctions are based on information shared by the company.
